To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the electrodynamic characteristics of the higher order mode in the RF deflecting structure are determined by the method of specifying the wave polarization, the method of specifying wave polarization is the most important parameter for the design of an RF deflecting device, and the most efficient method for specifying the wave polarizaton is the method with two grooves on the shell.

the higher order modes of an EH11 wave in the disk-loaded waveguide have a significant effect on the beam dynamics in an RF deflectors with a diaphragm with two holes, an oval-shaped coupling hole, and two grooves in the shell.
the higher-order modes are excited in a disk-loaded wave-guide with an elliptical coupling aperture, which can be used to measure the length and emittances of electron bunches.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new type of deflecting structures with higher order modes.
the design and development of a new generation of deflecting structures with higher order modes.
the development and investigation of a new type of RF deflectors for the system of bunch length and emittance measurements in free electron lasers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, although the EH11 mode is not a pure linear polarization mode, it has a sufficiently high degree of linear polarization.
the RF deflectors with an oval coupling aperture are preferable.
the higher order modes in an EH11 hybrid structure are not dangerous in terms of the stability of the wave polarization plane.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

it is possible to use the deflecting structure with a disk-loaded wave guide with a diaphragm with two holes, with the oval-shaped coupling aperture or with a shell with two grooves to measure the parameters of an electron bunch.

the RF deflecting system based on a disk-loaded wave guide with a coupling aperture in the form of two holes in the wall of the waveguide and with an oval-shaped aperture in the shell was chosen for the final design of the RF deflecting systems.
the best results were achieved for a deflecting structure with an oval-shaped aperture.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the electrodynamic parameters of a deflecting structure can be improved by using higher order modes.
the electrodynamic properties of higher order modes can be used in the development of RF deflectors.
the method of stabilizing the polarization of the EH11 hybrid wave by means of two grooves in the shell is the most effective one.
